blocks.text: Ek circuit lein jis mein coil, battery, switch aur rheostat series mein jure hain (Fig. 17.18). Rheostat ko tezi se hilayen to coil mein current badalta hai, coil ka magnetic flux bhi badalta hai, aur is se khud usi coil mein emf induce (paida) hoti hai.

blocks.title: Self-induction
blocks.text: Jab kisi coil mein badalta current usi coil ke andar emf paida kare, to is phenomenon (amal) ko self-induction kehte hain.
Farz karein coil ke ek loop (chakkar) se flux φ guzarta hai; N turns se total flux Nφ hai. φ magnetic field ke proportional (mutabiq) hai aur magnetic field current I ke proportional, is liye:

blocks.alt: Lambi coil jo switch, battery aur rheostat ke saath series mein hai; current I circuit mein ghoomta. Primary current ki magnetic field lines coil se guzarti hain, turns ke gird chhote gol teer. Labels primary current, aik turn mein induced current aur coil par induced emf dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.18: Coil khud apne andar induced current aur induced emf paida karti hui (kitab ki Figure 17.18 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rheostat tezi se hilane par current badalta hai, is liye coil ka apna flux badalta hai aur usi coil mein induced emf (ulti emf) paida hoti hai. Yeh emf current ke change (tabdeeli) ko oppose (mukhalfat) karti hai; isi ko self-induction kehte hain.
Yahan L proportionality constant hai jise coil ki self-inductance kehte hain.
Self-inductance L in factors par depend (munhasir) karti hai:

items: Core ka material (madda): coil ko ferromagnetic iron (lohe) ke core par lapeten to magnetic flux, aur is liye inductance, air core (hawa wale core) ke comparison mein bohat barh jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. (17.28)' ka reference (hawala) deti hai; asal mein Nφ = LI wali equation (17.29) istemal ho rahi hai.

Yahan L coil ki self-inductance hai aur minus ka sign (nishan) batata hai ke induced emf lagaye gaye voltage (current ke change) ko oppose karti hai (Lenz's law). Agar ε_L = 1 volt aur ΔI/Δt = 1 A s⁻¹ ho to L = 1 henry (H):

blocks.title: Henry
blocks.text: Agar coil mein current 1 A s⁻¹ ke rate se badle aur coil mein 1 V emf paida ho, to coil ki self-inductance 1 henry (H) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki definition ka aakhri hissa 'the coil has self-induce in a coil of 1 henry' ghalat chhapa hai. Sahi: coil ki self-inductance 1 henry (H) hai.
Self-inductance ko emf aur usi coil mein current badalne ke rate ka ratio (nisbat) bhi keh sakte hain. L ki SI unit V s A⁻¹ (henry) hai aur dimensions [ML²T⁻²A⁻²] hain.

blocks.title: Example 17.8
blocks.problem: Ek coil ki 50 Hz frequency par inductive reactance 160 Ω hai. Coil ki self-inductance nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: X_L = 160 Ω, f = 50 Hz

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab hal ki pehli line mein 'Induced reaction' aur 'f = 59 Hz' chhapti hai. Sahi 'inductive reactance' aur f = 50 Hz hai (sawal mein bhi 50 Hz hai aur hisaab bhi 50 Hz se hua hai).
